card.name: Sentence-opening pronouns and linking words in bios
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as his, their, as, like, with, from or when. They appear at the start of a sentence or clause, usually in biographical or descriptive web text, just after a name or a topic is introduced.

modes.label: Possessive after a name
modes.description: His or their right after a person or couple has been named in a bio.
modes.example: Jim and<< his>> wife Jenny live in Olympia, WA.

modes.label: Sentence-opening linker
modes.description: A short opening word like As, Like, With or Are starting a new sentence after a descriptive statement.

modes.label: Preposition in a credentials list
modes.description: From after a degree name in a list of qualifications.
modes.example: and an MBA<< from>> Stanford University Graduate School of Business.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words that start a sentence or follow a name in a short biography or description.
